comments.why: Community regenerating desert landscape in Saudi Arabia
comments.text: If this interests you, I've been watching a lot of permaculture and regenerative agriculture videos on YouTube and there is some really encouraging stuff going on out there! I have no idea how to make the restorative stuff go more mainstream, but it's really impressive to watch small communities or determined individuals entirely change a landscape in a few decades. comments.author: worldsayshi
comments.story: We need more water than rain can provide: refilling rivers with desalination
comments.text: My favourite solution to water scarcity is water traps. It seems like such an amazingly simple concept with underrated potential: Make sure that whatever water rains down in a place stays long enough to nudge the micro-climate in the right direction - by digging some water barriers in the right places. While it cannot possibly(?) solve water shortages everywhere it can turn some deserts green: [VIDEO]
